tuition_model.notes: Bilateral partner exchange per Excel; AY 2026-2027 DOCX fact sheet lists non-tuition expenses without explicitly printing tuition waiver wording.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2026-2027 fact sheet publishes semester non-tuition budgets rather than a monthly range (housing USD 4,930-7,040, meal plan USD 2,320-4,390, books USD 1,000, local transport USD 900, personal USD 2,000/semester).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No official monthly range published; see semester non-tuition USD breakdown in housing_notes and USD 11,430/semester financial proof in visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Incoming exchange students are NOT eligible for CUA's student health insurance plan and must purchase external compliant medical insurance (see https://studentinsurance.cua.edu/).

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing USD 4,930-7,040/semester (not guaranteed; off-campus portal also linked); meal plans USD 2,320-4,390/semester; est books USD 1,000, local transport USD 900, personal USD 2,000/semester.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Catholic University of America/2026-2027/Exchange Program Fact Sheet - CUA_ 2026-2027 Academic Year.docx

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Tuition Exchange Program (TEP) on catholic.edu applies to dependents of participating US member employees, not incoming international exchange students.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Minimum proof of finances USD 11,430 per semester required for incoming exchange visa documentation; lead time varies by embassy.
